facts.text: Hilshire Village got its name from a country estate in Hillshire, England, but the founders spelled it with one 'L' to create a unique identity.
Hilshire Village officially became a city on April 15, 1955, keeping its boundaries separate from Houston's expanding annexations.
The U.S. Postal Service treats all Hilshire Village mail as Houston, so residents must use 'Houston' on their envelopes.
Residents of Hilshire Village access the Spring Branch Memorial Branch of Harris County Public Library, located just outside the city in Hedwig Village.
The nearest public hospital for Hilshire Village residents is Ben Taub General Hospital, part of the Texas Medical Center.
Back in 1895, the area that would become Hilshire Village already had a post office and railroad service, hinting at early connectivity.
